9PK087LNGJC5.title: Balatro
9PK087LNGJC5.notes: Runs, renders and saves (saves stay local under AppData\Local\XodusGames). Real Xbox Live sign-in works: the game gets the signed-in gamertag and a signed achievements token through xodus-service. Closes on Alt+F4 / Stop (force-close watchdog).

9N9PCZWHVP2L.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
9N9PCZWHVP2L.notes: The Game Pass build is wrapped by the EasyAntiCheat bootstrapper (start_protected_game.exe), which has no Linux runtime; the launcher starts the real executable instead, so online modes are impossible ("ANTICHEAT FAILURE" tag on the title screen is expected). Passes the title screen and the licence check with the XStore/XPackage runtime commits (WineGDK branch xodus-launcher at 283602e, newer than the winegdk-20261010-4afaf0a release). Campaign not tested yet.

9P9VNSQK1W3K.title: Brotato
9P9VNSQK1W3K.notes: Godot 3 game built with a 2025 GDK: it acquires the licence of its DLC (9NLGSVFW9C0S) at boot and uses the PlayFab game-save API (PFXGameSave, IXGameSaveImpl4) for every save call; both need the WineGDK commits 5036159 and 113e74b (add-on licence handles, IXGameSaveImpl4 with a local save folder, no cloud sync). Renders at native resolution, signs in to Xbox Live, runs stable with those. Download needs xodus with PR #217 (carried in patches/xodus). Menu/gameplay not confirmed yet.

9NQ4M2DG11L0.title: RAYMAN LEGENDS
9NQ4M2DG11L0.notes: No Store package: the Xbox app only installs a stub that hands the game to Ubisoft Connect, so xodus-cli reports 'no PC package'. Install Ubisoft Connect with the Set up Ubisoft Connect button on this title (or Settings > Third-party launchers), sign in, activate PC Game Pass at https://gamepass.ubisoft.com/ with the Microsoft account that holds the subscription, download the game inside Ubisoft Connect, then use Link installed game… (docs/launchers.md).
